summary: Learn energy efficiency finance and project appraisal with Excel models, IPMVP, and bankability tools. Build stronger investment cases today.
lede: Energy efficiency finance and project appraisal helps energy, finance, and project professionals decide whether upgrades merit funding. Learners practice valuing savings with cash-flow models, net present value, and internal rate of return, while testing assumptions through scenario analysis and lifecycle cost assessment. They also examine funding structures, project risks, and bankability evidence to prepare recommendations for investment decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to evaluate energy efficiency projects, prepare funding cases, and support investment decisions with financial evidence.
modules: Energy Savings Valuation and Appraisal Metrics
Reporting and Decision Support for Energy Finance
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed and be ready to work with sample project data or your own retrofit case if available. No coding is required, but you should already be comfortable reading budgets, interpreting simple financial statements, and following energy audit outputs.
